evidence_quotes: LOTEAMENTOS IRREGULARES EM ÁREAS PROTEGIDAS E DE MANANCIAIS - DANOS URBANÍSTICOS E AMBIENTAIS.
loteamentos e parcelamentos irregulares e clandestinos havidos nas áreas de proteção de mananciais
rationale: This TJSP public civil action concerns urban and environmental damage caused by 32 irregular subdivisions (loteamentos irregulares e clandestinos) in watershed protection zones (áreas de proteção de mananciais), where the plaintiff sought monetary indemnity rather than environmental recovery. Under the mananciais-calibrated protocol rule, watershed protection zone enforcement is classified as WATER under environmental_protection. Because the dispute concerns land-use and environmental damage enforcement in áreas de proteção de mananciais rather than direct water/sanitation utility service access or water-resource abstraction/effluent adjudication, strict_service_access_label is marked UNCERTAIN and involves_connection_or_informal_settlement is false.
